nodes.label: Payload 3 CMS
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Sanity on 2026-10-01 because a shop is likely later and Payload's e-commerce plugin keeps it in the same admin; MIT licensed. Trade-off: self-hosted upkeep (DB, backups, updates) falls on the developer.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion fallback
nodes.rationale: Every motion item falls back to static or a fade; animations never hide content at rest (SEO + a11y).
